description: General-model consequence is equivalent to ordinary first-order consequence of the translated sentence from the translated theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.consequence_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Theory L)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Sentence L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Models T φ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.translateTheory T ⊨ᵇ
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.translateSentence φ
